Earlier I clicked (22,26) on the yellow plate's gray and (20,24) on the yellow itself — nothing happened. But maybe the click needs to be on the plate's center, or maybe the pin only moves to certain objects.
Let me try clicking the center of the yellow plate (20,24) — already did. The center of the blue 4×4 (20,19) — I clicked (21,19), close. Let me try the exact centers: blue (20,19), red (31,14), dark red (31,19), gray 4×4 (31,9), yellow plate (20,24).

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def diff(snap):
    b = snap.split('\n'); c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,cc,b[r][cc],c[r][cc]) for r in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[r][cc]!=c[r][cc]]
def tokens():
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,ch in [('N','N'),('Y','Y')]:
        out[name]=[(r,c) for r in range(10,54) for c in range(0,32) if L[r][c]==ch]
    return out
def pinpos():
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c) for r in range(10,54) for c in range(0,32) if L[r][c]=='b']
for target,name in [((20,19),'blue'),((31,14),'red'),((31,19),'dred'),((31,9),'gray4'),((20,24),'yellowplate'),((40,10),'green')]:
    s = current_frame.ascii
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':target[0],'col':target[1]}])
    d = diff(s)
    s2 = current_frame.ascii
    action(['RIGHT'])
    d2 = diff(s2)
    print(name, "clickdiff", len(d), "rightdiff", len(d2), [x for x in d2 if x[0]!=63][:8])
print("tokens", tokens())
print("pin", pinpos())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
